summary_en: On November 6, 2026, Sato Sho-ji executed a block share buyback via ToSTNeT-3 at the closing price of 2,612 yen on November 5. The transaction was capped at 300,000 shares (1.45% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) and 783.6 million yen in aggregate purchase price.
title_en: Notice of Share Buyback through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, Sato Sho-ji's board of directors authorized the execution of a share buyback via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange). The company proceeded to execute this buyback on November 6, 2026, at the closing price of 2,612 yen recorded on November 5.

The transaction was capped at 300,000 shares representing 1.45% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, with an aggregate purchase price limit of 783.6 million yen. The buyback order was placed during the designated ToSTNeT-3 trading window (8:45 AM) on November 6 and was valid only for that specific trading time. Results were announced after the conclusion of the morning trading session.
